description: This file defines models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing Fama-French US portfolio returns data, including data transformation and error handling.

classes.name: FamaFrenchUSPortfolioReturnsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching US portfolio returns, including portfolio choice, measure, frequency, start and end dates.

classes.name: FamaFrenchUSPortfolioReturnsData
classes.description: Represents individual data entries for US portfolio returns, including date, portfolio, measure, and value.

classes.name: FamaFrenchUSPortfolioReturnsFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching, transformation, and error handling for US portfolio returns data.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FamaFrenchUSPortfolioReturnsQueryParams object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from the Fama-French FTP based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw fetched data into a structured, flattened format suitable for analysis.
